## New in this release

### New
- **ID Austria login help:** on the login page, tap "My school requires parents' accounts to log in with ID Austria" for step-by-step instructions: log in to bildung.gv.at with ID Austria, open WebUntis, show the QR code under your profile → "Freigaben" (Sharing) → "Zugriff über Untis Mobile", and scan it. The scanner opens straight from that page.

### Absences
- **Tap an absence** to see all its details: date and time, duration, whether it's excused, the excuse status, the reason and the note.
- **Upcoming absences show up:** the list now reaches the end of the school year, so absences you report in advance are listed too.

### Fixed
- **Reporting absences works** (parent accounts). The school's server didn't accept the app's normal sign-in for it, so the app now opens a WebUntis web session like the browser does.
- ID Austria parent accounts work through the QR code, so they're no longer a known issue.

### Known issues
- Absences you reported can't be deleted in the app yet. Delete them on the WebUntis website.
